scope: Input entry audit; static source review and controlled production-function execution are identified separately. No Windows/game validation claim. No feature-internal algorithm review.

matrix.family_action: 消息泵 / 全部WM快捷键
matrix.entry: main message loop → IsDialogMessage → WM_HOTKEY → readOnlyWatchHotkey/handleHotkey

matrix.conclusion: 静态审查；没有发现吞掉全部WM_HOTKEY的源码分支；非Windows现场验证

matrix.conclusion: 生产函数执行验证；正常命令保持串行，未引入缺ACK猜测重放

matrix.family_action: 普通键物理兜底 / 全部命令族

matrix.conclusion: 受影响回归44场景193检查通过；不能证明现场GetAsyncKeyState一定有权限/一定看到极短按键

matrix.family_action: 松开 / 双击快捷键

matrix.conclusion: 发现并修复F2：pre5四类busy均导致自动开关2.5s后丢失；修后各1次

matrix.family_action: 载员逃生1696 / 自动维修1000

matrix.gates: 相应功能已开启；仍只接收合法新输入

matrix.conclusion: 本轮恢复用例通过；Runtime/OS实机焦点行为仍需现场日志

matrix.family_action: 原生消息所有权 / 暂停与恢复后的成对输入
matrix.entry: AssistFilterMessage central pair ledger → original owners → release-only fallback
matrix.gates: 只记录实际被WM_NULL消费的物理DOWN；只读时不采样物理键、不进入动作owner；normal owner先处理UP
matrix.recovery: 真正新DOWN/DBLCLK清旧所有权；repeat不清；feature reset与已ACKresume不丢原UP；新完整pair仍按配置恢复
matrix.conclusion: 执行验证：实际formation capture/layout/reset+中央filter，45场景188检查全过；开发中间态编译成功且37个预期失败。不是pre5现场根因证据

findings.title: formation WM fallback priority/epoch
findings.baseline: Current match preview is rejected by runtimeMiddleOwnsNow before formationHotkey; an old match can bypass that guard and steal the command.
findings.status: fixed in hotkey_host.h with current identity, binding, age and independent context watermark

findings.title: unrelated mailboxes block local actions
findings.baseline: All pending actions waited for command/selection queue and ACKs, including persistent local toggles and read-only pins. Four busy forms reproduce eventual expiry without dispatch.
findings.status: fixed with localHotkeyAction and Pending.popReady; game FIFO/age preserved

findings.title: formation lease bypass for immediate WM actions
findings.baseline: WM entry checked runtimeMiddleOwnsNow only, while sampler also checked formationInputOwns; an active post-gesture lease with inactive preview failed to protect immediate WM actions.
findings.status: fixed by keeping formationInputOwns in ordinary owner refusal

findings.title: old context message can revive after newly reachable formation handoff
findings.baseline: The intermediate priority fix alone allowed <=150ms old messages after reregister, short focus gap, or epoch change.
findings.status: three intermediate failing cases reproduced; fixed by context watermark distinct from owner cancellation

findings.title: read-only retirement loses physical input pair ownership
findings.baseline: Development intermediate, not released pre.5: command admission closes before an owned UP, or real formation reset removes feature ownership; after acknowledged resume the original UP still arrives without its swallowed DOWN.
findings.status: fixed by a central ledger of actual WM_NULL-consumed DOWN events; owners keep normal action decisions, only unmatched owned releases are retired without actions; new DOWN/DBLCLK clears lost ownership

limits: OS message delivery, UIPI and game-process execution were not exercised.
The command/watch/UI owner seams observe Host dispatch, not game completion or image rendering.
Missing ACKs still intentionally block subsequent game-changing commands; no speculative resend was added.
Native feature algorithms and multiplayer semantics are outside this entry audit.
Root and lifecycle/console agents separately own clock, pause/producer, explicit read-only protocol and UI control audits.
Final unified validation must rebind the fully settled source tree; this task did not freeze or commit a release.
